name: Devanshi Sharma

experience.description: Develop and maintain enterprise Java-based backend applications for Société Générale's Capital Markets platform using TCS BaNCS. Investigated and resolved 80+ UAT and production-impacting application issues through Java debugging, SQL-based data analysis, and root cause analysis. Implemented 20+ client-driven change requests and backend enhancements across multiple release cycles. Supported 10+ UAT and production release cycles, performing API validation with Postman and troubleshooting release blockers.

Built backend applications using Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Spring Security, and REST APIs as part of enterprise training projects. Developed cloud-based solutions using AWS and Azure services, including Virtual Machines, RDS, Lambda, and App Services. Collaborated on feature implementation and CI/CD activities using Jenkins, with frontend integration using React and Angular.

Developed backend features for catalogue management and product content approval workflows serving internal business teams. Collaborated with cross-functional product and engineering teams to implement feature enhancements based on operational requirements.

projects.title: AI-Powered Job Search Automation Platform
projects.description: Architected a polyglot microservice platform — Spring Boot orchestrating DB lifecycle, REST APIs, and UI; FastAPI as the AI/ML worker running Ollama (llama3.1) for structured resume parsing. Built a 5-component weighted semantic matching engine (cosine similarity, skill overlap, YOE decay, domain and location fit) and JobSpy-based multi-portal discovery across LinkedIn and Indeed. Cut daily job-screening effort from ~40 minutes to under 2 minutes and increased job discovery volume 40x.
